verdict.rationale: Twilio's docs carry a one-off notice that the Authy API is closed to new customers and 'will be fully deprecated in the future', plus a migration guide to Verify. That is a single end-of-life announcement with no timeline, not a documented deprecation policy. The pack also shows no API versioning for Authy, and no programmatic surface remains open for an AI-native user to rely on.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The Authy API is now closed to new customers and will be fully deprecated in the future.
For more information about migration, see Migrating from Authy to Verify for SMS
